content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for BCKV Field/Lab Assistant Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.bckv.edu.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 28-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the BCKV Field/Lab Assistant posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the BCKV Field/Lab Assistant recruitment is 28th September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Field/Lab Assistant position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's degree, preferably a Graduate in Science. Additional qualifications like a Diploma/Certificate in computer courses and relevant experience are also desirable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Field/Lab Assistant posts?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Field/Lab Assistant posts is between 21 years and 35 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Field/Lab Assistant role?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Field/Lab Assistant position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 20,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Field/Lab Assistant post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Field/Lab Assistant position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the BCKV Field/Lab Assistant recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and submit it via post.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the BCKV Field/Lab Assistant posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Field/Lab Assistant posts.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Field/Lab Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Field/Lab Assistant posts involves a Personal Interview and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Bidhan Chandra Krishi Viswavidyalaya (BCKV), which is www.bckv.edu.in.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for the Field/Lab Assistant position?
faq.answer: The Field/Lab Assistant position is a contractual job, as indicated in the recruitment notification.
